paragraphs: See the entry Rav Assi, Rav Ashi’s colleague, and the entry Iti.[^1]

notes.text: Full Rav appears for heading Iti, target Assi and colleague Ashi; the second target אתי has no title. Heading איתי and target אתי remain separate spellings despite the same inherited Iti rendering. Two textual pointers do not establish identity.
